definitions.explanation: The first half of a period of time, event, work, or game.

examples.japanese: {試合|しあい}の{前半|ぜんはん}が{終|お}わった。
examples.english: The first half of the game ended.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}の{前半|ぜんはん}は{忙|いそが}しかった。
examples.english: The first half of this year was busy.

examples.japanese: {映画|えいが}の{前半|ぜんはん}は{静|しず}かだが、{後半|こうはん}から{一気|いっき}に{展開|てんかい}が{動|うご}き{出|だ}す。
examples.english: The first half of the film is quiet, but the plot starts moving rapidly from the second half.

notes:
Antonym of {後半|こうはん} (second half). Used for time periods, events, games, books, and other things that can be divided into halves.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{前半|ぜんはん}{戦|せん} (first half of a match)
・{年|ねん}の{前半|ぜんはん} (first half of the year)
・{前半|ぜんはん}{部分|ぶぶん} (first-half portion)
